name: Equal Earth
alt: World map in the Equal Earth projection
summary: Preserves relative area while offering a balanced, contemporary world-map appearance.
use: Global thematic maps comparing area-based phenomena.
watch: Shape and distance are not preserved everywhere.

name: Web Mercator
alt: World map in the Web Mercator projection
summary: Preserves local angles and aligns with the tiled maps used by many web-mapping services.
use: Interactive navigation and display of tiled web basemaps.
watch: Area distortion grows rapidly toward the poles. Do not use it to measure or compare areas.

name: Robinson
alt: World map in the Robinson projection
summary: Balances several kinds of distortion to create a recognizable and visually pleasing world view.
use: General-reference world maps where no single property must be exact.
watch: Neither area, shape, distance, nor direction is exactly preserved.
